## What's new

### Consistent top bar
- The **PC picker** is now on the left of the top bar on both Home and Library. It stays pinned at the top while you scroll, with the iOS 26 Liquid Glass bar.
- **Status on the right**, on every tab: game controller (with its battery level when the controller reports it), network (Wi-Fi, cellular or offline), iPhone battery and the clock. iPhone hides the system status bar in landscape, so Starlight shows its own, drawn with SF Symbols.
  - iOS doesn't let apps read Wi-Fi signal strength, so the network icon shows the connection type only.

### Search
- **Search** is now its own button at the bottom right, separate from Home, Library and Settings, like the Photos app on iOS 26. It searches every game on the selected PC.
- The search field was removed from Library.
- On iOS versions before 26, Search appears as a fourth tab.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
